system.description:
A bardiche: a war-axe on a long haft, plain and heavily nicked. Carried through the war of independence by a veteran of the Watchers. Some say its head was forged from the iron of mine shackles struck off freed miners.

Bonus: +2 to attack and damage rolls, and it counts as magic.

Slots: 1

Quirk (Oath-bound): Linkbreaker will not serve a slaver. While you hold any creature in chains against its will, the weapon loses its +2 and its power until the creature is freed.

Slots: 1

Break the Chain: On a hit, you may cut one shackle, chain, net, rope or magical binding holding a creature within your reach. That creature is no longer Restrained by it.

Slots: 1
